hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { git diff --quiet HEAD -- src/pwsh-prompt-rs && [ -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard src/pwsh-prompt-rs)" ]; } && exit 0; out=$(cargo clippy --quiet --all-targets --manifest-path src/pwsh-prompt-rs/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
